entries.title: II Timothy 1:1
segments: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, according to the promise of life which [is] in Christ Jesus,

entries.title: II Timothy 1:2
segments: to Timothy, [my] dearly beloved child. Grace, mercy, peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

entries.title: II Timothy 1:3
segments: I thank God, whom I serve from [my] forefathers with pure conscience, that without ceasing I remember you in my prayers night and day,

entries.title: II Timothy 1:4
segments: greatly desiring to see you, being mindful of your tears, so that I may be filled with joy,

entries.title: II Timothy 1:5
segments: taking recollection of the unfeigned faith that is in you, which first dwelt [in] your grandmother Lois, and in your mother Eunice. And I am persuaded that it is in you also.

entries.title: II Timothy 1:6
segments: Therefore I remind you to inflame anew the gift of God, which is in you by the putting on of my hands.

entries.title: II Timothy 1:7
segments: For God has not given us the spirit of fear, but of power and of love and of a sound mind.

entries.title: II Timothy 1:8
segments: Therefore do not be ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, nor [of] me His prisoner. But be partaker of the afflictions of the gospel according to [the] power of God,

entries.title: II Timothy 1:9
segments: who has saved us and called [us] with a holy calling, not according to our works, but according to His own purpose and grace which was given us in Christ Jesus before the eternal times.

entries.title: II Timothy 1:10
segments: But it is now made manifest by the appearing of our Savior Jesus Christ, who has made death of no effect, bringing life and immortality to light through the gospel;

entries.title: II Timothy 1:11
segments: to which I am appointed a preacher and an apostle and a teacher of the nations.

entries.title: II Timothy 1:12
segments: For this cause I also suffer these things; but I am not ashamed, for I know whom I have believed, and I am persuaded that He is able to keep that which I have committed to Him against that Day.

entries.title: II Timothy 1:13
segments: Hold fast the pattern of sound words which you have heard from me, in faith and love [which is] in Christ Jesus.

entries.title: II Timothy 1:14
segments: Guard the good Deposit [given] through [the] Holy Spirit indwelling in us.

entries.title: II Timothy 1:15
segments: This you know, that all those in Asia have turned away from me, of whom are Phygellus and Hermogenes.

entries.title: II Timothy 1:16
segments: May the Lord give mercy to the house of Onesiphorus, for he often refreshed me and was not ashamed [of] my chain.

entries.title: II Timothy 1:17
segments: But when he was in Rome, he sought me out very diligently and found [me].

entries.title: II Timothy 1:18
segments: May the Lord grant to him that he may find mercy from [the] Lord in that Day. And in what things he ministered [to me] at Ephesus, you know very well.
